comments.text:
Suggested order. Source: Claude Doc "Biblicus Review: Platform Fit and Improvements" (https://claude.ai/code/artifact/8b797c1b-5c8c-4931-acd6-1655b52f6f79).

Independent, start now: blbs-d8fc85 (repo hygiene), blbs-bc9c7d (roadmap and scope docs), blbs-1aca09 (delete merged branches, needs delete permission), blbs-45b76d (branch triage).
Critical path: blbs-12b984 (land curation branches) then release. Then blbs-def144 (Corpus paths and env names), blbs-12cfcf (typed api), blbs-5e783e (metadata.papyrus), blbs-af04bd (Papyrus runner and dependency).
After the curation release: blbs-49f6fb (split cli.py), blbs-f801df (Tactus gate), blbs-ca6f88 (drop supervised loop), blbs-67eb7d (Cyclotron shadow mode; blbs-ca6f88 waits on its result).

Partial work saved on branches: claude/project-thread-dmru5y-repo-hygiene, claude/project-thread-dmru5y-corpus-contract, claude/project-thread-dmru5y-roadmap-scope. None is verified or has a PR. All need current origin/main merged in (PR 60, PR 61, v1.11.4 landed after they were cut).
